question: A 55-year-old man with newly diagnosed HFrEF (LVEF 32%) and no contraindications is being initiated on guideline-directed medical therapy. Which combination represents the four evidence-based pillars of HFrEF pharmacotherapy?

answers.text: ACE inhibitor, loop diuretic, digoxin, aldosterone antagonist

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Loop diuretics relieve congestion symptoms but do NOT reduce mortality. Digoxin has a narrow role (rate control in AF with HF) but does not form a disease-modifying pillar. The four pillars that reduce mortality/hospitalisation are: ACEi/ARB/ARNI + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor.

answers.text: ACE inhibitor or sacubitril/valsartan, beta-blocker, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (spironolactone/eplerenone), SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin/empagliflozin)

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. The four mortality-reducing pillars in HFrEF are: (1) ACEi/ARB/ARNI (sacubitril-valsartan preferred if tolerated); (2) Evidence-based beta-blocker (carvedilol, bisoprolol, or metoprolol succinate); (3) MRA (spironolactone or eplerenone); (4) SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin or empagliflozin). Each pillar independently reduces cardiovascular death and hospitalisation.

answers.text: ACE inhibitor, calcium channel blocker (amlodipine), MRA, SGLT2 inhibitor

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Calcium channel blockers (except amlodipine/felodipine for angina/hypertension) are generally avoided in HFrEF as they can worsen systolic dysfunction and increase mortality. The beta-blocker — not a CCB — is the second pillar.

Incorrect. Ivabradine (If-channel inhibitor) is an add-on therapy for symptomatic patients in sinus rhythm with HR ≥70 bpm despite maximally tolerated beta-blocker; it is not a first-line pillar. The four pillars include a beta-blocker, which ivabradine cannot replace.

overallFeedback.feedback: The four evidence-based pillars for HFrEF mortality reduction are: (1) ARNI/ACEi/ARB, (2) Beta-blocker (carvedilol/bisoprolol/metoprolol succinate), (3) MRA (spironolactone/eplerenone), (4) SGLT2 inhibitor. Loop diuretics, digoxin, and ivabradine have more limited roles.
Correct. Remember ABMS: ARNI/ACEi/ARB + Beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2 inhibitor — the four pillars proven to reduce mortality in HFrEF.
